method: Cross-source verification of the complete Nadia 2013 handbook office synopsis against the separate final-order positive-mention extraction. Join only within harmonized office tier on unique exact casefolded names with collapsed whitespace. No fuzzy matching, punctuation removal, spelling correction, or inferred blocks.
name_uniqueness_rule: Handbook name must occur exactly once within the office tier. Order name must occur exactly once within its office tier and stated axis. A name printed once in caste and once in women is two separate positive-axis claims, each compared independently; it does not justify joining a duplicated handbook GP name.

axis_rules.caste: Compare the positive order caste against the handbook caste axis. Normalize only the category label BC to OBC; preserve both raw codes.
axis_rules.women: Compare an explicit positive women-column mention against the handbook women axis.
axis_rules.omission: No missing order mention is treated as a negative or UR claim.

blank_pradhan_serial_123_check.finding: No unique exact GP-head name match supplies explicit reservation evidence for the blank Pradhan serial 123 in the current order extraction. The handbook category remains null.
blank_pradhan_serial_123_check.limits: The order contains positive mentions only, with mostly unreviewed OCR names. An unmatched name cannot establish source absence or unreserved status; spelling and punctuation variants are deliberately not joined. Deputy-office evidence is never transferred to Pradhan.
